extracted.intended_audience: appointed nominating bodies (organisations) and the Award Jury for the Astrid Lindgren Memorial Award
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and requirements for organisations entitled to nominate candidates (authors, illustrators, storytellers, and reading promoters) for the Astrid Lindgren Memorial Award, including eligibility, documentation, submission format, timing, and limits on nominations. Focused on ensuring valid, timely, and rule-compliant nominations for the annual award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Jury right to reject invalid nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: The jury maintains the right to reject late or incomplete nominations, nominations from organisations not approved by the jury or nominations otherwise invalid according to the nomination rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations that are late, incomplete, from unapproved organisations, or otherwise invalid per the nomination rules may be rejected by the jury. Ensure compliance with all rules and deadlines to avoid rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination period (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: The nomination process usually opens in the beginning of March and closes in the middle of May.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If dates are unclear, contact nomination@alma.se. Submit within the specified window to be considered; late submissions risk rejection under the jury's rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible nominators
rubrics_metrics.description: Only the appointed nominating bodies and the Jury are entitled to propose candidates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the official List of nominating bodies to confirm entitlement; individuals or organisations not on that list are not permitted to submit nominations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on self-nomination and internal nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominating bodies may neither nominate themselves, their own projects, nor a project where the nominating body is a co-organiser. A nominating body may not nominate individuals that are part of the management of their own organisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid conflicts of interest by not nominating your own organisation, co-organised projects, or management personnel. Such nominations are disallowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible categories of nominees
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominating bodies may propose authors, illustrators and storytellers whose work for children and young adults is of the highest artistic quality, and also individuals, organisations, projects or the like that have carried out exceptional work to promote reading for children and young adults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations are for creators (authors, illustrators, storytellers) and reading promoters whose work targets children and young adults. Consider both artistic creators and organisations/activities that promote reading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artistic and humanistic standard for nominees
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominees' work should be "of the highest artistic quality" and "echo the same profound spirit of humanity that characterized Astrid Lindgren’s own work"; statutes stipulate laureates shall "convey the deeply humanistic spirit associated with Astrid Lindgren."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate candidates against high artistic standards and a humanistic spirit resonant with Astrid Lindgren's work; the award is intended for work that embodies these qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award is for an entire body of work
rubrics_metrics.description: The award is for an entire body of work, not an individual piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominate based on the candidate's overall contribution and corpus, not a single book or project.

rubrics_metrics.name: No posthumous awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The award cannot be given posthumously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not nominate deceased persons; nominees must be living at the time of nomination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number and category limits per nominating body
rubrics_metrics.description: Each nominating body is entitled to nominate a total of four candidates in the following categories: author, illustrator, oral storytelling and reading promotion. It is allowed for a candidate to be nominated in more than one category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you submit no more than four total nominations across the listed categories. You may nominate the same candidate in multiple categories if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographical limits on nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: A maximum of two candidates from the nominating body’s own country and a maximum of two candidates from other countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When selecting up to four nominees, do not exceed two nominees from your own country nor more than two from abroad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documents and mandatory fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The documents that should accompany a valid nomination are specified in the nomination form. The mandatory fields in the nomination form must be completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the official nomination form (see sample forms: Nominating a person / Nominating an organisation). Complete all mandatory fields and include all specified supporting documents to ensure the nomination is valid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-nomination procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: In the case of a re-nomination, it is sufficient to send in the first page of the nomination form with the name of the re-nominated candidate; however, information that relates to new works or contains any other relevant new information should also be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For re-nominations, you may submit only the first page naming the candidate unless there are new works or other new relevant information—then include those updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission format and address
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominations may be submitted through the e-service, by e-mail (nomination@alma.se), or by regular mail to Kulturrådet, Att. Nomination, P.O. Box 27215, SE-102 53 Stockholm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the e-service if available; otherwise submit by email or postal mail to the provided address. Follow the specified submission channel requirements to avoid technical rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validity duration of a nomination
rubrics_metrics.description: A nomination is only valid for the year in question.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominations do not carry over to subsequent years; nominating bodies must re-nominate candidates in later years subject to the nomination limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination language requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The forms for nomination are available in English and Swedish. The nomination form must be submitted in one of these two languages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the nomination in English or Swedish only; other languages are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment equality principle
rubrics_metrics.description: All candidates have an equal chance, regardless of the nominating body. A candidate’s chances are not dependent on the number of nominations received for the candidate in question.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The jury assesses candidates on merits; multiple nominations for the same candidate do not improve chances. Ensure fairness and impartiality in submissions.
